primary_usage_basis: Last event_msg token_count info.total_token_usage, as used by Harbor trajectory conversion and agent_result.
reasoning_counter_admission: Only a legacy runtime counter matching Harbor input, cache and output totals exactly.
cost_basis: Harbor reports runtime cost when supplied, otherwise estimates using its LiteLLM pricing table. Do not call this an invoice.
alternate_counter: token_usage_record.payload.thread_token_usage is retained separately if present. Its totals may differ; no undocumented scope equivalence is assumed.
timing_basis: Agent and total wall-clock durations from Harbor phase timestamps. CPU-seconds and peak memory not measured.
